notes.title: Goblin Dash is released in early access on Steam! 🥳
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43347835/22d820586709e9e464d0b461a17dd32f70ce1c67.jpg[/img]

Hi, everyone! 🙌
We are happy to announce that our game is in early access on Steam! 🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2206410/Goblin_Dash/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

Goblin Dash is an action platformer game where the player controls a small goblin character and tries to complete challenging levels. 

The game plays similarly to other action platformer games, allowing the player to move the goblin character up and down to jump across platforms and defeat enemies. 

The game challenges the player with difficult abilities and mechanics, and requires skill as a platformer to complete. Overall, Goblin Dash is an action-packed and challenging platformer game.

[url=https://discord.gg/E7RXsHcppA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43347835/fcf474262240c9eaa6fa41454946f9341ea19e1e.png[/img][/url][url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41519224][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43347835/af6324e0d6200e3888c1a58847a16ad4dff2a23e.jpg[/img][/url]

That’s enough for today’s blog, we would like to see all of you on our page.
We can’t wait to bring the full version. 🚀

Hope that you can try our game and give us your feedback! 🤓

notes.title: 👑🐸Pepe Lord 🐸👑
notes.content:
We are excited to write down our first blog. We have been working on our game for a while and it will be 
available for you to try on Steam Next Fest 6 February 2023.

You’ll also be able to join the developer stream on February 6th, 2023. We are humbled by your continuous support from day one.
If you haven’t already heard of it Goblin Dash plays similarly to other action platformer games, allowing the player to move the goblin character up and down to jump across platforms and defeat enemies. The game challenges the player with difficult abilities and mechanics, and requires skill as a platformer to complete. 
That’s enough for today’s blog, we would like to see all of you on Steam Next Fest. We can’t wait to bring the full version.

Our Discord server is ready here for you to jump in if you would like to reach us directly.

Don’t forget to add to your wishlist, stay tuned!
